parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of a bucket, typically made of metal wire or rod, attached to the upper rim of the bucket.
parts.Functional_description: The handle allows the user to lift and carry the bucket easily, providing leverage and balance when filled with liquid or solid materials.
parts.Movement_description: The handle can pivot or rotate around its attachment points to the bucket body, allowing it to move up and down for carrying or resting positions.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the bucket, typically cylindrical and made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds liquids or solids, providing the main storage volume of the bucket.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is a rigid, non-moving part that serves as the structural container for the bucket.
